outcome: recurrent benign goiter with intratracheal extension
cohort: A 37-year-old pregnant patient with a history of total thyroidectomy who developed worsening dyspnea due to a recurrent benign goiter with intratracheal extension.
finding: A pregnant patient with a history of total thyroidectomy developed a recurrent benign goiter with intratracheal extension during pregnancy, which spontaneously regressed postpartum after an emergency cesarean section and tracheostomy.
mod_finding: The patient underwent an emergency cesarean section due to worsening dyspnea related to the goiter.
